One Week of Quiet Rhythm

Kids & Family Edition
A gentle time to meet with Jesus together

You’re already welcome here—this quiet week on paper is a porch, not a race.

Same family thread on the site: Family hub · Print hub · Year-round rhythm

“In the morning, O Lord, Thou wilt hear my voice…” (Psalm 5:3, KJV)

Morning Quiet Time

Monday — Psalm 5:3

“In the morning, O Lord, Thou wilt hear my voice: in the morning will I direct my prayer unto Thee, and will look up.”

Tuesday — Lamentations 3:22-23

“It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed… They are new every morning.”

Wednesday — Psalm 118:24

“This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.”

Thursday — Psalm 143:8

“Cause me to hear Thy lovingkindness in the morning… for I lift up my soul unto Thee.”

Friday — Psalm 90:14

“O satisfy us early with Thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad.”

Saturday — Psalm 46:10

“Be still, and know that I am God…”

Sunday — Psalm 19:14

“Let the words of my mouth… be acceptable in Thy sight, O Lord.”

What did I notice about God today?

What stood out to me? (or tell a grown-up)

My simple prayer to Jesus

Evening & Family Time

“I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep…” (Psalm 4:8, KJV)

One thing I’m thankful for today

Family Table Question (any evening this week)

“What is one thing you noticed about God’s world or God’s Word today?”

Take turns sharing. Listen with big hearts — there are no wrong answers. God loves hearing from you!
How to use: Print one for each person or share one together. Draw, write, or just talk. Some days you might only do the morning part — that’s okay. Jesus is glad you came.
“Be still, and know that I am God.” (Psalm 46:10, KJV)
